2024_general.fact: '2024-11-05 Election Day Canvass Results (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 4902): 'Canvass Results Report ... Election Day ... Run Time 10:01 PM ... Run Date 11/05/2024', per-precinct rows (e.g. precinct 1: 413, 64, 0, 4 for President). PDF CreationDate Nov 6 04:01 UTC (10:01 PM CST). DocumentCenter sends no Last-Modified, so no upload time. File located through a cached search result; the Past Elections DocumentCenter folder is script-driven and its listing could not be read, so other election-night versions cannot be ruled out.

2026_primary.fact: No March 2026 results files listed on Current Elections; Past Elections DocumentCenter folder (Index/507) listing is loaded by script and could not be read. No Clarity. Check 3 pending (no wayback folder).

2026_runoff.fact: Current Elections page lists EV and ED unofficial files once each. 'ED Precinct Results with Aliases-5-26-2026 - Unofficial-WM (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 7136): 'Precinct Results ... Unofficial Results ... Election Day PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION ... Run Time 8:31 PM ... Run Date 05/26/2026', Precinct 1 Ken Paxton Election Day Voting 28, John Cornyn 6 (header oddly shows 'Precincts Reporting 0 of 18'). CreationDate May 27 01:32 UTC (8:32 PM CDT). No upload time (no Last-Modified).

rationale: 2024 general and 2026 runoff END (one election-day precinct report printed on election night), primary undetermined, so PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT. Low because there are printed run times but no server upload times.
